# Issue template

Copy to `docs/issues/ISSUE-<n>-<slug>.md`.

```md
# ISSUE-<n>: <short title>

- **Affected feature**: `.kiro/specs/<feature>/specs.md`
- **Severity**: critical | high | medium | low
- **Reported by**: <name>
- **Assigned to**: <name>
- **Date**: YYYY-MM-DD

## Steps to reproduce
1. ...
2. ...

## Expected behavior
<per specs.md>

## Observed behavior
<what actually happened>

## Evidence
<logs / screenshots / order or quote ID>

## Root cause (fill when investigated)


## Planned fix (reference to tasks.md)
FIX-ISSUE-<n>: ...

## Resolution (fill when closed)
- **Fixed by**: <name>
- **Closed on**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Resolution**: fixed | won't fix | duplicate | cannot reproduce
```
